brief.prompt: Seed pitch for Thermacore, which retrofits industrial boilers with heat-pump modules that run on waste heat.
brief.ask: Raise a $4M seed to fund three paid pilots

outline.governing_thought: Thermacore retrofits industrial boilers with waste-heat pumps, cutting fuel use without replacing plants, and three paid pilots will prove it.
outline.ask: Raise a $4M seed to fund three paid pilots
key_points: Industrial boilers waste heat and burn costly fuel
Heat-pump modules reuse waste heat inside existing plants
Retrofit avoids the cost and downtime of full replacement
Paid pilots turn the technology into repeatable contracts
